quotations.english: nobles shall hear of your inglorious deed

quotations.old_english: Sceolon nú ǽfre dreógan dómleáse gewinn
quotations.english: now we shall ever wage powerless war
death tore them all away, hapless they fell

source_text: dóm-leás; adj. Inglorious, powerless, hapless; ingl&o-long;rius, imp&o-short;tens, infort&u-long;n&a-long;tus :-- Æðelingas gefricgean dómleásan dǽd nobles shall hear of your inglorious deed, Beo. Th. 5772; B. 2890. Sceolon nú ǽfre dreógan dómleáse gewinn now we shall ever wage powerless war, Cd. 218; Th. 279, 3; Sat. 232. Ealle swylt fornam, druron dómleáse death tore them all away, hapless they fell, Andr. Kmbl. 1989; An. 997.
